column1: # *** THE LINES OF THE NAME, DRAWN SIDE BY SIDE. 11 October 2026. ***
# *** WHY THIS EXISTS. *** This archive had 542 people when this was written (11 October 2026; the register now holds 738) and had never once drawn the question it is
# actually asking: *** ARE THESE ONE FAMILY OR SEVERAL? *** It has a descent ladder for three houses,
# a tree with the missing joint broken open, and a page about the rarity of the name - and nothing
# that puts the distinct families of LERENA beside each other so a reader can tell them apart.
# *** THE RULE FOR ADDING A LANE: a lane must have a BEGINNING and an END, both documented. ***
# An empty band is a true statement; a guessed one is not. Households that are real but not yet on
# any lane go BELOW the rule, so this picture cannot quietly imply that everything has been placed.
# nodes and ends are ';;'-separated; each node is 'place|year|what the document says'.
# *** 25 October 2026: THE KIT'S DRAWING (BranchRivers). *** The page no longer carries its own Lines.astro; tools/build-lines.py makes
# site/src/data/lerena-lines.json from this file, data/lerena-lines-unplaced.tsv and data/people-lines.tsv, and `npm run check:lines` holds it to the kit contract.
# status      documented | inferred | origin-unknown | family-lore. A RESEARCH DECISION, written by hand, from what this archive's own pages and data say.
# span        the first and last DOCUMENTED year ("1791-1903"); a node outside it is a node that rests on something other than a document.
# statusnote  the words after the tier on the page (no more than the status line allows); it says what is inferred or what is not found.
# node_person the person page of each node, ";;"-separated and in step with nodes ("" for a node that is not one person).
# node_evidence the source word of each node, in step with nodes: "" = read from the document; inferred | indexed | tree | ... draws the node hollow.

column7: Canelones|1791|SANCHO LLERENA AGUILAR marries at the Catedral Nuestra Senora de Guadalupe, 8 January 1791. He could not write: nine years later he deposes as a witness and the judge signs for him.;;Montevideo|1793|His son PEDRO ANTONIO is baptised 31 July 1793 - the house is in the city within two years.;;Cordon|1830|JUSTA PASTORA marries at Nuestra Senora del Carmen; the Cordon is the family's parish for fifty years.;;Cordon|1871|ALEJANDRO MAXIMO x ELISA VILLADEMOROS, 28 December. His mother signs as a witness.;;Union|1880|Two granddaughters baptised on 8 March, naming AVELINO and AMBROSIA TRAIBEL as grandparents.;;San Jose de Mayo|1880|ZELMIRA CARLOTA LERENA LARRIERA is born 4 November, one of the nine children of ALBERTO LERENA and MARIA INES LARRIERA. This archive first set her aside as 'not ours' on 14 September 2026 and retracted that on 21 September: her father's Montevideo death act of 2 March 1921 names his parents as AVELINO LERENA and AMBROSIA TRAIBEL, so she is a great-granddaughter of Sancho.;;Pocitos|1903|MARIA MARGARITA LUISA ZALDUONDO LERENA baptised - the fourth generation in the city.
column9: Sancho's house. Four generations in and around Montevideo, and the only line here whose first document is a marriage rather than an arrival.
column11: origin inferred Andalucía; the town rests on trees only

column2: Out of Rosario del Colla, into Trinidad
column7: Rosario del Colla|1800|RAMON LERENA, Alcalde de la Santa Hermandad del Partido del Rosario, "en la otra Banda Oriental", inventories an estate across five weeks and signs his own name.;;Colla|1837|MAURICIO LERENA x CASIMIRA MONTANO marry - the couple the Trinidad kindred descends from.;;San Jose de Mayo|1874|Their daughter FELICIA marries at the Catedral Basilica, 19 December.;;Trinidad|1882|Their son MANUEL marries in April - a second, independent thread from Colla into Flores.;;Trinidad|1889|TWO LERENA SISTERS MARRY TWO CARDOZO BROTHERS ON ONE DAY, 25 April.;;Trinidad|1911|CUSTODIO x EMA CARDOZO, dispensed as double first cousins - the knot those weddings tied.
column9: Ramon's house. The only lane whose earliest document is a man holding office, and the one that folds back on itself by marriage within two generations.
column11: origin inferred: natural de Madrid on a son's 1816 baptism

column1: direct
column2: Rosario de Santa Fe, to the Cape
column7: Rosario de Santa Fe|1882|PABLO ARMANDO LERENA is born 22 February. His baptism has never been found - the cathedral register was read act by act for February and March.;;Buenos Aires|1908|His army enrolment card names his parents: JUAN CARLOS LERENA and MARIA LERENA. Neither has been found in any record anywhere.;;Cape Town|1915|In South Africa he is ROBERT PAUL LERENA.;;Newlands|1950|He dies at Newlands, 19 March.
column9: This is the line the archive exists for, and it is drawn broken on purpose. Both ends are documented and the middle is not: NO RECORD HAS EVER BEEN FOUND FOR HIS PARENTS, and no lane above has been shown to contain them.
column11: origin not found: the joint is missing, his parents are on one card only

column2: Out of Spain, into Buenos Aires
column7: Spain|1886|ELOY LERENA born, "natural de Espana" on his daughter's baptism.;;Barcelona|1911|GREGORIO and FELISA LERENA sail on the INDIANA, landing 7 December.;;San Jose de Flores|1912|JUANA baptised 10 November, daughter of ELOY and FELISA, BOTH LERENAS, both Spanish-born.;;Bilbao|1923|A FELISA LERENA arrives with four children.;;Logrono|1930|EMILIO LERENA, born 1900, arrives on the CONTE ROSSO.
column9: A Spanish stock arriving three times in twenty years. NOT SHOWN TO BE CONNECTED TO ANY URUGUAYAN LANE, and the passenger-list people are NOT merged into the parish ones - the ages are two years out and the roles do not line up.
column11: three arrivals, not shown to be connected

column7: Spain|1860s|ARTURO LERENA GARCIA, Spanish, a journalist - and the man who broke this archive's rule that every Cajon 985 father was Uruguayan.;;Valparaiso|1894|His ten-month-old son JUAN FERNANDO LERENA DIAZ dies there (the Valparaiso death act names his parents ARTURO LERENA GARCIA and AMALIA DIAZ).;;Buenos Aires|1909|The household is at Villa Crespo.;;Parana, Entre Rios|1938|A VICENTE LERENA DIAZ keeps the civil register at Pueblo Brugo - SNIPPET ONLY, the act is not opened.
column9: The only lane that reaches a fourth country. Its last node is a search-result snippet and is drawn as one.
